t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Points are between 0-9. Certain gnomes will have higher points then after a while the points you'd get from the gnomes will change. I've been told that Gnomes that are red, blue, pink, and purple are good at start  then further on are brown yellow green and orange

vb_textbox.text: Different coloured Gnomes will provide points between 0-9. There are 2 groups under certain colours. E.G group 1 are Red, Blue, Pink and purple. Group 2 is made up of Brown, yellow, green and orange gnomes. One group will provide more points than the other at any time given. From my try at the game if x1 is lower than say 3 then the other group most likely will give you more points though sometimes provides 0 it's just a risk you'd have to take. also x5 is also bit funny at time, I think if it's lower than 20 points then the other group may give more then again the group that gives the most points will change at any time. Good luck.
